title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Chapman University
description: Discover the essential late-night food spots near Chapman University, from on-campus dining halls to the historic eateries of Old Towne Orange.

cards.title: Midnight Snacks at The Caf
cards.subtitle: On-campus dining hall
cards.notes: Visit the main dining hall for late-night food service until 1:00 AM daily, providing a safe on-campus option for students with meal plans.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus dining hall offering late-night service until 1:00 AM for Chapman students.
cards.evidence_claim: Randall Dining Commons serves until 1 a.m. every day for Chapman students.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM daily for students; meal plans or payment required.

cards.title: Late Slices in the Circle
cards.subtitle: Old Towne Orange pizzeria
cards.notes: Walk two blocks to the Orange Circle for New York-style slices available until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A local favorite in Old Towne Orange serving New York-style pizza with late-night weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Zito's Pizza in Old Town Orange is open Friday and Saturday from 11am to 1am.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.

cards.title: The Tustin Avenue Run
cards.subtitle: Classic California burger joint
cards.notes: Drive to Tustin Street for a late-night Double-Double; the drive-thru stays open until 1:00 AM or later every night of the week.
cards.short_summary: A quintessential Southern California late-night destination located a short drive from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The In-N-Out at 2585 N. Tustin St. is open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Orange, CA, 2585 N. Tustin St. - In-N-Out Burger

cards.title: 24-Hour Cravings
cards.subtitle: Fast food on Tustin Street
cards.notes: Head to the 24-hour Taco Bell on North Tustin Street for a reliable late-night meal at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast food option located near campus for students needing a meal after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 490 N Tustin St in Orange is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Orange, CA - 490 N Tustin St

cards.title: Custom Pies in the Plaza
cards.subtitle: Build-your-own pizza
cards.notes: Create your own pizza at this newspaper-themed spot in Old Towne Orange, open until 11:00 PM or midnight for late study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A build-your-own pizza restaurant in the historic district with late evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pizza Press Orange is open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and 12:00 AM Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Milky Bun Dessert Run
cards.subtitle: Hand-scooped ice cream
cards.notes: Grab a signature Milky Bun or a scoop of Cookie Monster ice cream at this Glassell Street shop, open until 10:00 PM or later.
cards.short_summary: A trendy ice cream shop in Old Towne Orange known for unique flavors and late-night dessert options.
cards.evidence_claim: Afters Ice Cream at 117 N Glassell St has online ordering hours until 10:10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until at least 10:00 PM.

cards.title: The 24/7 Convenience Stop
cards.subtitle: Glassell Street convenience store
cards.notes: Stop by the 7-Eleven on Glassell Street for 24/7 access to snacks, drinks, and quick meals just north of the main campus area.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store providing essential snacks and supplies for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 1679 N. Glassell St is open 24/7.

cards.title: Early Morning Coffee Run
cards.subtitle: Coffee and donuts
cards.notes: Fuel up for early morning classes or late-night cramming at the Dunkin' on Glassell Street, opening as early as 5:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A reliable spot for coffee and donuts with very early morning hours for Chapman students.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin' locations in the area typically open at 5:00 AM for early morning service.

cards.title: On-Campus Caffeine
cards.subtitle: Campus coffee shop
cards.notes: Located in Beckman Hall, this on-campus Starbucks provides a convenient spot for coffee and snacks during evening study hours.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus Starbucks location for students to gather and study with caffeine.
cards.evidence_claim: Starbucks is located in Beckman Hall on the Chapman campus.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open until 9:00 PM or 10:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Argyros Forum Bagel Break
cards.subtitle: On-campus bagel shop
cards.notes: Grab a bagel or sandwich at Argyros Forum; this spot is a staple for students looking for a quick meal between evening activities.
cards.short_summary: A popular on-campus eatery in Argyros Forum offering bagels and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein Bros Bagels is located in Argyros Forum on the Chapman campus.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours are Monday-Thursday until 5:00 PM, with some late-night availability during special events.
